title: LC 并联槽路：只让一个频率通过
summary: 10 kΩ 串一个 10 mH ∥ 100 nF 的槽路。扫频找槽路的谐振频率，再用电流表量槽路里来回流的电流，看它比外面的电流大多少倍。
concepts: 谐振时导纳虚部为零 susceptance cancels
description: 信号发生器 → R1（10 kΩ）→ VT；VT 到 GND 并联 L1（10 mH）和 C1（100 nF）。CH1 看 VIN，CH2 看 VT。谐振时槽路像一个很大的电阻，VT 最大；L、C 之间的环流远大于流进来的电流。

cards.title: 一个很尖的峰
text: 信号发生器：**正弦波、幅度 `1 V`**，频率从 **`2.5 kHz`** 往 **`10 kHz`** 调。峰很窄，到中间要**非常慢**地调。
大部分频率下 CH2 几乎是一条平线。在哪里它突然变大？

cards.title: L 和 C 在里面荡秋千
text: - 谐振时，能量在电感的磁场和电容的电场之间**来回倒**：电容放电推动电感，电感再把电容反向充满……就像荡秋千。
- 这股电流只在 L 和 C 之间转圈。从外面看，L 的电流和 C 的电流大小几乎相等、方向相反，**互相抵消**。外面只需要补一点线圈电阻上的损耗。
![](fig:tank)
- 所以谐振时槽路像一个**很大的电阻**，VT 几乎等于 VIN；偏离一点，L 或 C 就把信号短路到 GND。谐振频率和串联时一样：
$$f_0 = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{LC}}$$
![](fig:select)

cards.title: 找 f0，量里外两个电流
text: - **扫频**：找 CH2 最大、和 CH1 同相的频率，读那里的幅度比（CH2 ÷ CH1）。
- **电流表**的表盘写着 “DC A”，显示的是**平均值**——正弦电流的平均值几乎是 0。**点一下电流表**，右侧「属性」里的「有效值 RMS」才是要读的数。
- 外面的电流：把 R1 右脚挪到 **`b7`**，电流表红笔插 **`a7`**、黑笔插 **`a10`**。
- 里面的电流：把 L1 上面那只脚挪到 **`c13`**，再放一块电流表，红笔 **`b10`**、黑笔 **`a13`**。两块表都在频率停在 $f_0$ 时读。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **并联谐振**：L、C 的电流互相抵消，槽路阻抗最大，输出最大。偏离 $f_0$，槽路很快变成小电感或小电容。
- 槽路里的**环流**可以是外面电流的几百倍。收音机就是用这样的回路“选台”的。
- 坑：仿真里线圈电阻只有 1 Ω。真实 10 mH 小电感常有 10～30 Ω，峰会低很多、宽很多——这就是“品质因数”名字的来历。

caption.text: 谐振时 I_L 和 I_C 大小几乎相等、方向相反：它们在 L、C 之间转圈（回路箭头），从 R1 流进来的 I 只是很小的一点。

i18n.en: At resonance I_L and I_C are almost equal and opposite: they circle between L and C (the loop arrow); the I coming in through R1 is only a trickle.

caption.text: VT 随频率变化：只有 f_0 附近很窄的一段能通过。

i18n.en: VT against frequency: only a narrow band around f_0 gets through.

en.title: Parallel LC tank: only one frequency gets through
en.summary: 10 kΩ in series with a 10 mH ∥ 100 nF tank. Sweep for the tank's resonance, then use the ammeter to compare the current sloshing inside the tank with the current coming in.
en.description: Generator → R1 (10 kΩ) → VT; L1 (10 mH) and C1 (100 nF) in parallel from VT to GND. CH1 on VIN, CH2 on VT. At resonance the tank looks like a very large resistor and VT peaks; the current circulating between L and C is far larger than the current coming in.
compare: - At f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) ≈ 5033 Hz the inductor's and capacitor's susceptances cancel, leaving only a tiny real part, so the tank impedance peaks: Z0 ≈ L/(rC) = 10 mH / (1 Ω × 100 nF) = 100 kΩ.
- R1 and 100 kΩ then form a divider: VT/VIN ≈ 100/(10 + 100) ≈ 0.91, phase ≈ 0.

- Away from resonance the tank impedance collapses: at f0/2 = 2.5 kHz, Z ≈ jωL/(1 − ω²LC) ≈ j211 Ω (inductive — the inductor branch carries most current), VT/VIN ≈ 0.021, phase ≈ +88°; at 2f0 = 10 kHz, Z ≈ −j105 Ω (capacitive), VT/VIN ≈ 0.021, phase ≈ −89°.
- Bandwidth: the whole circuit's Q ≈ (R1 ∥ Z0)/√(L/C) ≈ 9.1 kΩ / 316 Ω ≈ 29, so BW = f0/Q ≈ 175 Hz — only about 4.95 to 5.12 kHz gets through. That is how a radio's tuned circuit "picks a station".

**Think about it (circulating current)**: at resonance only about 6.5 µA (RMS) flows into the tank through R1, while about 2.0 mA flows back and forth between L and C — over 300× the outside current (≈ the tank's own Q = √(L/C)/r ≈ 316). Energy sloshes between the inductor's magnetic field and the capacitor's electric field; the outside only has to make up the loss in the winding resistance. (Phasor diagram: I_L and I_C are almost equal and opposite.)

measurements.ask: Sweep: the frequency f0 where VT peaks and is in phase with VIN (0° phase difference)
measurements.explain: f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) ≈ 5.03 kHz: the inductor's and capacitor's susceptances cancel.

measurements.ask: f = 5033 Hz: amplitude ratio VT/VIN (CH2 Vpp ÷ CH1 Vpp)
measurements.explain: The tank impedance Z0 ≈ L/(rC) = 100 kΩ divides with R1: 100/110 ≈ 0.91.

measurements.ask: f = 5033 Hz: the ammeter in series with R1, its RMS value under Properties (the current into the tank)
measurements.explain: The tank looks like about 100 kΩ: ≈ 0.707 V / 110 kΩ ≈ 6.5 µA.

measurements.ask: Same frequency: the ammeter in the inductor branch, its RMS value (L1's current)
measurements.explain: I_L ≈ V_T / (ωL) ≈ 0.64 V / 316 Ω ≈ 2.0 mA: energy swings back and forth between L and C.

measurements.ask: From your two readings, the circulating-current ratio I_L / I_R1
measurements.explain: ≈ 300, close to the tank's own Q = √(L/C)/r ≈ 316. The outside only has to make up the winding-resistance loss; I_L and I_C are nearly equal and opposite.

hints: L1 and C1 are side by side, both from VT to GND; R1 connects the generator to VT.
At f0 the tank looks like a very large resistor; away from f0 it looks like a small L or C.
Sweep slowly near the peak: the band is very narrow.
tests: f0: VT peaks, in phase with VIN
f0: the circulating tank current is far larger than the current in R1
f0/2 = 2.5 kHz: inductive tank, VT is small
2f0 = 10 kHz: capacitive tank, VT is small

cards.title: A very sharp peak
text: **Resistor** (`10 kΩ`) into **`b3`**–**`b10`**. **Inductor** (`10 mH`) into **`c10`**–**`tn10`**, **capacitor** (`100 nF`) into **`d10`**–**`tn11`**: L and C side by side, both from VT to GND.
Generator: **sine, amplitude `1 V`**; turn the frequency from **`2.5 kHz`** towards **`10 kHz`**. The peak is narrow — near the middle, turn **very slowly**.
At most frequencies CH2 is almost a flat line. Where does it suddenly grow?

cards.title: L and C play on a swing
text: - At resonance the energy **sloshes back and forth** between the inductor's magnetic field and the capacitor's electric field: the capacitor discharges into the inductor, the inductor charges the capacitor the other way round… like a swing.

- That current only circles between L and C. From outside, the L current and the C current are almost equal and opposite and **cancel**. The outside only has to make up a little loss in the coil's resistance.
![](fig:tank)
- So at resonance the tank looks like a **very large resistor** and VT is almost VIN; a little off, and L or C shorts the signal to GND. The resonant frequency is the same as in the series circuit:
$$f_0 = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{LC}}$$
![](fig:select)

cards.title: Find f0, measure the inside and outside currents
text: - **Sweep**: find the frequency where CH2 is largest and in phase with CH1; read the amplitude ratio there (CH2 ÷ CH1).

- The **ammeter**'s face says "DC A" and shows the **average** — and the average of a sine current is almost 0. **Click the ammeter**: the "RMS" line under Properties on the right is the number to read.
- The outside current: move R1's right lead to **`b7`**; ammeter red lead into **`a7`**, black into **`a10`**.
- The inside current: move L1's top lead to **`c13`** and add a second ammeter, red **`b10`**, black **`a13`**. Read both with the frequency at $f_0$.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Parallel resonance**: the L and C currents cancel, the tank's impedance is largest and so is the output. Away from $f_0$ the tank quickly turns into a small inductor or capacitor.
- The **circulating current** inside the tank can be hundreds of times the current coming in. A radio "picks a station" with a circuit like this.
- Pitfall: the simulated coil has only 1 Ω of resistance. A real small 10 mH inductor often has 10–30 Ω, so the peak is much lower and wider — which is where the name "quality factor" comes from.

tests.name: f0：VT 最大，和 VIN 同相
f0：槽路里的环流远大于 R1 的电流
f0/2 = 2.5 kHz：槽路呈感性，VT 很小

compare: - 在 f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) ≈ 5033 Hz，电感和电容的电纳互相抵消，Y 只剩一个很小的实部，槽路阻抗达到最大：Z0 ≈ L/(rC) = 10 mH / (1 Ω × 100 nF) = 100 kΩ。
- 偏离谐振，槽路阻抗迅速变小：f0/2 = 2.5 kHz 时，Z ≈ jωL/(1 − ω²LC) ≈ j211 Ω（感性，电感支路电流大），VT/VIN ≈ 0.021，相位 ≈ +88°；2f0 = 10 kHz 时 Z ≈ −j105 Ω（容性），VT/VIN ≈ 0.021，相位 ≈ −89°。
- 带宽：整个电路的 Q ≈ (R1 ∥ Z0)/√(L/C) ≈ 9.1 kΩ / 316 Ω ≈ 29，BW = f0/Q ≈ 175 Hz——只有约 4.95 ~ 5.12 kHz 这一小段能通过。收音机的调谐回路就是这样“选台”的。
**想一想（环流）**：谐振时从 R1 流进槽路的电流只有约 6.5 µA（有效值），而在 L 和 C 之间来回流动的电流约 2.0 mA——是外部电流的 300 多倍（≈ 槽路自身的 Q = √(L/C)/r ≈ 316）。能量在电感的磁场和电容的电场之间来回交换，外面只需要补充线圈电阻上的损耗。（相量图：İL 和 İC 大小几乎相等、方向相反。）

measurements.ask: 扫频：VT 最大、和 VIN 同相（相位差 0°）的频率 f0
measurements.explain: f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) ≈ 5.03 kHz：电感和电容的电纳互相抵消。

measurements.ask: f = 5033 Hz：幅度比 VT/VIN（CH2 的 Vpp ÷ CH1 的 Vpp）
f = 5033 Hz：串在 R1 里的电流表，「属性」里的有效值（流进槽路的电流）
measurements.explain: 槽路几乎像 100 kΩ 的电阻：≈ 0.707 V / 110 kΩ ≈ 6.5 µA。

measurements.ask: 同一频率：电感支路里的电流表，有效值（L1 的电流）
measurements.explain: I_L ≈ V_T / (ωL) ≈ 0.64 V / 316 Ω ≈ 2.0 mA：能量在电感和电容之间来回交换。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个读数算环流放大倍数 I_L / I_R1
measurements.explain: ≈ 300，约等于槽路自身的 Q = √(L/C)/r ≈ 316。外面只需补充线圈电阻上的损耗；İL 和 İC 大小几乎相等、方向相反。

hints: L1 和 C1 并排放，都从 VT 接到 GND；R1 把信号发生器接到 VT。
f0 时槽路像一个很大的电阻；偏离 f0 时它像一个小电感或小电容。
在峰值附近要慢慢调：通带很窄。
